mapper.select: SELECT id, survey_code, initiation_id, ticket_id, warranty_id, score, level, professionalism, timeliness, quality, attitude, comments, suggest, anonymous, evaluator_id, evaluator_name, evaluated_at, follow_up, follow_up_note, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_satisfaction WHERE survey_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, survey_code, initiation_id, ticket_id, warranty_id, score, level, professionalism, timeliness, quality, attitude, comments, suggest, anonymous, evaluator_id, evaluator_name, evaluated_at, follow_up, follow_up_note, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_satisfaction WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY evaluated_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, survey_code, initiation_id, ticket_id, warranty_id, score, level, professionalism, timeliness, quality, attitude, comments, suggest, anonymous, evaluator_id, evaluator_name, evaluated_at, follow_up, follow_up_note, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_satisfaction WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY evaluated_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT AVG(score) AS avg_score, AVG(professionalism) AS avg_professionalism, AVG(timeliness) AS avg_timeliness, AVG(quality) AS avg_quality, AVG(attitude) AS avg_attitude, COUNT(1) AS total FROM pmis_satisfaction WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT level, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM pmis_satisfaction WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY level ORDER BY level
